fnol_text: My name is Dana Rasmussen and I live at 172 Linden Way, Madison, WI 53790. You can reach me on (555) 622-4529 or dana.rasmussen@example.com. On 26 December 2024 I tried to drive through a flooded road under the bridge. The water was deeper than I thought and the engine cut out and filled with water. Policy MT-2023-00138. I'd like to claim for the damage to my car.

adjuster_notes.text: Called Dr Rasmussen on (555) 622-4529 to acknowledge the claim. Dana confirmed the loss date as 26 December 2024.
Vehicle inspected at the repairer. Witness Dmitri Petrov gave a statement by phone.
Dana sent photos and a contractor's estimate. Water line visible on walls.
